description.value: Smoke & Bones BBQ is an authentic Southern-style barbecue restaurant on North Vancouver's Marine Drive, cooking meats low and slow in hardwood smokers sourced from the Deep South. The owners trained under pitmasters Dr. BBQ and Paul Kirk — a 7-time World BBQ Champion — and hold both the Canadian National BBQ Championship and a US Best-of-the-Best Rib title. Cyclists can eat inside or on the heated outdoor patio, with takeout and Metro-wide delivery also available.

address.value: 999 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, BC V7P1S4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at smokeandbones.ca is live and confirms the OSM address (999 Marine Drive, North Vancouver V7P1S4), restaurant phone (604-770-1394), and active operation ('Open Daily at Noon', copyright 2026). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Order Pickup Order Delivery') and vegetarian options are present via a dedicated 'Non-Meat Sides N' Sweets' menu section and a Beyond Burger listed as 'Great non meat option!'.
concerns: OSM name is 'Smoke and Bones' but website primary branding is 'Smoke & Bones BBQ'; website footer also uses 'Smoke and Bones BBQ'. Minor punctuation discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, award-winning BBQ restaurant on the North Shore with dine-in, heated patio, and takeout — a strong food stop for touring cyclists on Marine Drive.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Non-Meat Sides N' Sweets' section, a Beyond Burger described as 'Great non meat option!', Los Cabos Salad, Mexican Street Corn Salad, Caesar Salad, and Brussels Sprouts
